claims.claim: A CNN analysis of public data published September 24 found combined trading on 2026 election markets on Kalshi and Polymarket above $750 million, and CNN has a partnership with Kalshi.
claims.episode_span: Trading on twenty twenty-six election contracts at Kalshi and Polymarket has topped seven hundred fifty million dollars, according to a CNN analysis of public data published September twenty-fourth
claims.source_title: Midterm Election Betting Tops $750M on Kalshi and Polymarket
claims.supporting_quote: A CNN analysis of public data published Sept. 24 put combined trading volume on 2026 election markets on the two platforms at more than $750 million. CNN, which has a partnership with Kalshi and uses its data in coverage, reported that the markets on which party will control Congress had drawn a combined $32 million on Kalshi and Polymarket, while many closely watched House battlegrounds had less than $100,000 in volume.

claims.claim: ACDC data current to September 30 counted $221 million on 21,811 congressional midterm markets across Polymarket, Polymarket US and Kalshi, versus $92.4 million for the entire 2024 congressional cycle, and projected $1.4 billion to $1.6 billion.
claims.episode_span: counts two hundred twenty-one million dollars already bet on twenty-one thousand eight hundred eleven congressional-midterm markets
claims.source_title: Midterm Election Betting Tops $750M on Kalshi and Polymarket
claims.supporting_quote: Its latest Gambling on Democracy update , with data current to Sept. 30, covers 21,811 markets on the 2026 congressional midterms across Polymarket, Polymarket US and Kalshi. The group counts $221 million already bet on those races, compared with $92.4 million for the entire 2024 congressional cycle.

claims.claim: ACDC's August report said only 8 percent of the eventual 2024 total had been bet at the comparable point, and that assumption produced the $1.6 billion estimate while average volume per market produced $1.4 billion.
claims.episode_span: an August report found only eight percent of the eventual twenty twenty-four total had been bet at the comparable point
claims.source_title: Midterm Election Betting Tops $750M on Kalshi and Polymarket
claims.supporting_quote: In its August report , the group said only 8% of the eventual 2024 total had been bet at the comparable point in that cycle. Assuming the same share for 2026 produced the $1.6 billion estimate, while applying 2024's average volume per market to the number of 2026 markets produced $1.4 billion.

claims.claim: Only 16 percent of this cycle's congressional markets relate to who wins, 58 percent focus on margin, and in 2024 71 percent of election markets were on race winners.
claims.episode_span: Only sixteen percent of this cycle's congressional markets relate to who wins a race, with fifty-eight percent focused on margin of victory
claims.source_title: Midterm Election Betting Tops $750M on Kalshi and Polymarket
claims.supporting_quote: Only 16% of this cycle's congressional markets relate to who wins a race, with 58% focused on a candidate's margin of victory, Reuters reported based on ACDC data. In 2024, 71% of election markets were on race winners.

claims.claim: Michelle Kendler-Kretsch told Reuters that most volume is still wagered on who will win and many esoteric markets are barely traded.
claims.episode_span: researcher Michelle Kendler-Kretsch told Reuters that most volume is still wagered on who will win
claims.source_title: Midterm Election Betting Tops $750M on Kalshi and Polymarket
claims.supporting_quote: Most volume is still wagered on who will win, ACDC researcher Michelle Kendler-Kretsch told Reuters, and many of the more esoteric markets are barely traded.

claims.claim: Kalshi has suspended at least six 2026 candidates this year for betting on their own races, a Polymarket spokesperson cited a 98 percent accuracy rate one day before an election, and Benjamin Freeman said election prediction markets are well-calibrated.
claims.episode_span: Kalshi has suspended at least six twenty twenty-six candidates this year for betting on their own races
claims.source_title: Midterm Election Betting Tops $750M on Kalshi and Polymarket
claims.supporting_quote: Kalshi has suspended at least six 2026 candidates this year for betting on their own races, CNN reported, and a Polymarket spokesperson told Reuters the company's election markets have a 98% accuracy rate one day before an election. "Election prediction markets are well-calibrated," Kalshi head of politics growth Benjamin Freeman told CNN.

claims.claim: On October 9 the CFTC proposed defining event contracts including sports, politics, cultural and weather events as swaps; Selig said they are within the agency's exclusive jurisdiction; a companion interim rule places US sportsbook and casino wagers outside that definition.
claims.episode_span: On October ninth the Commodity Futures Trading Commission proposed expressly defining event contracts, including those based on sports, politics, cultural and weather-related events, as swaps
claims.source_title: Midterm Election Betting Tops $750M on Kalshi and Polymarket
claims.supporting_quote: On Oct. 9, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission proposed expressly defining event contracts, including those based on sports, politics, cultural and weather-related events, as swaps. Chairman Michael Selig said in the announcement that the products are "within the agency's exclusive jurisdiction." A companion interim rule places wagers on US sportsbooks and casino games outside that definition.

claims.claim: A Reuters/Ipsos poll from September 30 through October 5 found 60 percent of U.S. adults oppose using prediction markets to wager on election results, 13 percent support it and 24 percent are not sure.

claims.supporting_quote: A Reuters/Ipsos poll conducted Sept. 30 through Oct. 5 found 60% of U.S. adults oppose using prediction markets to wager on election results, while 13% support it and 24% are not sure.

claims.claim: In a Friday post, CFTC Chair Mike Selig described prediction-market exchanges as matching quotes nationwide and said Congress authorized the CFTC to enforce uniform standards and act against fraud and manipulation across state lines.
claims.episode_span: CFTC Chair Mike Selig, in a Friday post, described prediction-market exchanges as businesses operating across state lines

claims.supporting_quote: Separately, Selig described prediction-market exchanges as businesses operating across state lines, matching purchase and sale quotes from customers nationwide.
